Author: Subodh Abhyankar Bench: Subodh Abhyankar

NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:32238  1   IN THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH  AT INDORE  BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE SUBODH ABHYANKAR  ON THE 7 th OF NOVEMBER, 2025  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 14004 of 2024  STATE OF M.P.
 Versus  SHUBHAM  Appearance:
 Shri Vishal Singh Panwar-GA for the applicant appearin  Advocate General.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH  AT INDORE
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: They are heard and perused the documents.

2] This is an application filed under Section 439 (2) of Cr.P.C./483(3) of B.N.S.S. for cancellation of bail of respondent /accused Shubham, who has been granted bail by this Court in M.Cr.C.
No.9906/2023 dated 1.4.2023 in connection with Crime No.783/2022 registered at Police Station Kotwali Dewas, District-Dewas (MP) under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Sections 5(L)
and 6 of POCSO Act, 2012.
3] Counsel for the applicant has submitted that subsequent to release of respondent, the respondent has again committed another offence at Crime No.439/2023 at Police Station Industrial Area,
District Dewas (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Section 25 of the Arms Act, 1959 wherein he was found in possession of a folding knife, and thus, his order of bail deserves to be recalled.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:32238 2 MCRC-14004-2024 4] On due consideration and on perusal of the record, it is found that so far as the earlier order of bail is concerned, the respondent was granted bail by this Court as the prosecutrix had not supported the case of the prosecution and had also given no objection being a consenting party.

Whereas in the subsequent case, which was registered in the year 2023, the respondent might have already been granted bail by the Court, and the status of the earlier case is also not filed on record, in which the respondent was granted bail two and half years ago.

In such circumstances, this Court does not find it to be a fit case State Of M.P. vs Shubham on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186837573/
1 to cancel the bail of the respondent.
5] Accordingly, the application is hereby dismissed.

(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) JUDGE das State Of M.P. vs Shubham on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186837573/
